title: Generic material fixture — inspection and remaining limits

notes.title: Procedural veneer is still uniform
notes.observation: The vertical direction is clear, but the grain lacks the panel-specific variation of production veneer.
notes.action: For a full scene, use licensed physically scaled veneer maps and compare every exposed face.

notes.title: Corner remains a simple assembly
notes.observation: The fixture has matching 70 mm top/end thickness. Its straight corner seam is not a resolved bonded mitre.
notes.action: Use the kitchen chapter to separate exposed arris easing from bonded-joint easing and inspect a dedicated corner view.

notes.title: Textile is only a surface sample
notes.observation: The authored folds are orderly and the fine weave is weak at this scale. This is not the production throw.
notes.action: For a sofa, build weighted support, unequal overlap, scaled yarn and attached full fringe, then review overhead and the full hem.
